paradigm: Response inhibition (Go/No-Go) scored with signal detection theory: d' and criterion c
citation: Drewe, E. A. (1975). Go-no go learning after frontal lobe lesions in humans. Cortex, 11(1), 8-16. Green, D. M., & Swets, J. A. (1966). Signal detection theory and psychophysics. Wiley.
stimulus: Gauge needle: on zero = Go, deflected = No-Go
randomness: seedrandom(seed); 3 draws per trial in fixed order: isGo, side, jitter
note: Documentation only. Runtime reads CONFIG in game.js and the mode tables in go-no-go-extra-modes.js.
